name: Long March 2D
location_str: LC-9 @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The 55th launch of the year for China's CASC, 625th all time. That is a launch every six days. No Long March 2D has failed in 70 flights.
slot_b_text: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
